arguments.name: Rendered four-region chromatic distribution error
arguments.description: Mean sqrt Jensen-Shannon divergence (base2) between reference and rendered72-bin jointHS histograms over four fixed image quadrants, independent scoring frames then canonical source families. Reference masks and neutral-RGB render visibility support fixed before arms; empty prediction on reference-valid region has distance1. Primary oracle comparator sees identical target information/palette choices. Conditional on frozen C trajectory/camera, not audio predictability or taste.
arguments.noise_note: No noise sigma or powered MDE measured at registration; no numeric noise floor is assumed.
